title: EPM Data Source Catalog Entry
description: Schema for a single reusable data source entry in the EPM catalog.

type.description: Access level: who may receive this data. Drives what can be published.

category.description: Nature of the source, independent of its access level. A derived series built from public databases is still open_source.

date.description: Year or date of the source document, e.g. '2022' or '2022-07'

file.description: Filename of the source document (no full path)

access_note.description: Where to find this file internally (for non-public sources)

countries.description: ISO3 or common names of countries covered, or the string 'all' for a global source

fills_epm_resources.description: Which EPM CSV resources this source can fill

location.description: Slide, page, table or section reference within the source

coverage.description: What aspect of the resource is covered

derived_files.description: Files produced from this source that are not EPM resources (processed CSVs, indexes, notebooks input)

path.description: Repo-relative path of the produced file

source_file.description: Which file of the source it came from

used_in.description: Analyses that consume this source without going through an EPM resource

confidence.description: high = validated official data; medium = modeller elaboration; low = proxy/assumption

notes.description: Known caveats, limitations, or validation status

used_in_studies.description: List of EPM deployments that used this source
